claim: Refit noisy multi-reader rank-one H3 DAS on v1/v2 rows, select checkpoints on the complete v8 cue/construction family with the pooled step-zero axis eligible, and evaluate selected, pooled, and DIM axes once on v10/v11.
novelty: The preceding temporal H3 fit held out rows within each fitted family and demonstrably memorized the family. This experiment moves checkpoint selection to an entirely different cue/template family and makes no update a legal selected outcome.

frozen_partition.gradient_rows: even rows of v1_A1, v1_A2, v2_A1, and v2_A2
frozen_partition.checkpoint_selection: all jointly capable v8_A1 and v8_A2 rows
frozen_partition.sealed_evaluation: all jointly capable v10_A1/A2 and v11_A1/A2 rows
frozen_partition.excluded_after_outcome: v9 is not used because its outcome for the preceding optimized axis is already open

predictions.selector_positive_control: The v8 family score rejects the previously observed same-family shortcut relative to pooled aligned.
predictions.robust_update: A nonzero selected checkpoint beats pooled aligned in sealed v10/v11 mean and worst multi-reader score.
predictions.safe_no_update: If no trained checkpoint beats pooled aligned on v8, step zero is selected and exactly preserves the pooled sealed baseline.
predictions.stable_reader: The selected axis beats DIM in every sealed reader family.

null: A moved axis selected by v8 that regresses relative to pooled aligned on v10/v11 is residual construction-family memorization and ends penalty tuning for this object.
